policy: Prioritize high-fit, inspectable resources. Do not mass-submit the same pitch. Check each target's current contribution rules immediately before contacting them, preserve CBT Cards safety/evidence/licensing boundaries, and use the smallest canonical resource that fits the directory. A target is not submitted merely because its process was researched.

status_definitions.not_contacted: Current fit exists but the submission path has not yet been fully rechecked.
status_definitions.ready_requires_fork: Current rules require a pull request/fork; content fit is acceptable but this execution environment cannot fork the target repository.
status_definitions.blocked_by_catalog_license_policy: The target's current inclusion rules expect a permissive license that CBT Cards does not currently grant.
status_definitions.needs_format_adaptation: The target uses a different skill/registry format that needs an explicit adaptation review.
status_definitions.monitor_auto_index: The target appears to index upstream skills automatically; check inclusion before requesting manual action.
status_definitions.blocked_by_license_decision: The target's reuse/full-text model intersects open CBT Cards licensing decision #7.
status_definitions.needs_org_eligibility_check: Submission eligibility or organizational/contact requirements remain unverified.
status_definitions.needs_submission_path_check: Topical fit is known but a current submission path is not verified.
status_definitions.submitted: A real submission was made through the target's documented process.
status_definitions.accepted: The target accepted or merged the submission.
status_definitions.declined: The target explicitly declined the submission.

targets.name: dreamingechoes/awesome-mental-health
targets.evidence: Current contribution guide requires one individual pull request per resource, alphabetical placement, short description, spelling/grammar checks, and evidence appropriate to the type of resource. It explicitly exempts small tools/apps from the high-quality clinical-evidence requirement used for therapy claims.
targets.blocker: The documented submission path is a pull request. The current connected GitHub tool can read the repository but cannot fork it, so no issue-based workaround should be used.
targets.fit_note: Pitch the reviewed public practice library as a small general-wellness/self-reflection resource, not clinical treatment or efficacy.

targets.name: theimpossibleastronaut/awesome-mentalhealth
targets.evidence: Current contribution guide asks contributors to prioritize end-user usefulness, prefers HTTPS web resources, and accepts English resources. No issue-based resource-suggestion template or established issue submission path was found in the 19 Aug recheck.
targets.blocker: A repository contribution is the defensible path; the connected GitHub tool cannot fork the target repository.
targets.fit_note: Lead with free browser-local worksheets, HTTPS, no-submit behavior, and narrow educational/general-wellness scope.

targets.name: Agent Skill Exchange
targets.evidence: Current documented submission process is fork the catalog repository, create skills/<slug>/SKILL.md, and open a pull request. The catalog requires its own skill metadata/profile and a real upstream source.
targets.blocker: The connected GitHub tool has no fork operation. Copying/adapting the skill into a third-party catalog should also preserve CBT Cards' active CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 terms rather than inherit the catalog repository license by implication.
targets.fit_note: Strong technical fit because CBT Cards has a portable skill, immutable versions, provenance, safety boundaries, and evals; preserve its license and non-clinical scope in any future catalog copy.

targets.name: dmgrok/agent-plugins (formerly agent_skills_directory)
targets.evidence: The current New Provider issue flow performs automated validation and can create an auto-PR, but its explicit provider requirements say the repository must have a proper license such as MIT or Apache 2.0 and skills must score 70+.
targets.blocker: CBT Cards currently uses CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Do not submit while the target explicitly expects permissive-style licensing; open issue #7 must be resolved deliberately first.
targets.fit_note: Technical validation/security model is a strong fit, but eligibility fails on the current license boundary before quality scoring even matters.

targets.name: block/agent-skills
targets.evidence: Goose Skills Marketplace source repository welcomes community skills through pull requests and validation.
targets.fit_note: Recheck current packaging/license requirements before adapting the portable skill; do not weaken safety/publication boundaries.

targets.name: JPeetz/agent-skills
targets.evidence: Cross-platform Agent Skills collection with validation/eval expectations; current standards require MIT-licensed skills, so copying the current CBT Cards CC BY-NC-SA skill would not satisfy its stated policy.
targets.blocker: Current target skill policy expects MIT licensing while CBT Cards' active skill license is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
targets.fit_note: Strong eval/spec fit, but do not mislabel the CBT Cards license to qualify.

targets.name: All-The-Vibes/skills-catalog
targets.evidence: Agent Skills catalog with documented new-skill contribution process and cross-assistant positioning.
targets.fit_note: Check category/domain and license fit first; its current catalog is engineering-heavy.

targets.name: openmodelsrun/skills
targets.evidence: Community-maintained skills registry with documented schema validation and PR contribution flow.
targets.fit_note: Their canonical format differs from portable SKILL.md; adapt metadata only after license/format review and do not claim exercised runtime behavior.

targets.name: bbwdadfg/ai-agent-skills-index
targets.evidence: Daily-generated public index of Agent Skills with machine-readable metadata and links to upstream repositories.
targets.fit_note: Verify automatic discovery before requesting manual intervention.

targets.name: lawrence3699/agent-skills-corpus
targets.evidence: Reproducible public Agent Skills corpus that records source metadata and publishes full text only for clearly licensed skills.
targets.fit_note: Metadata discovery is relevant now; full-text redistribution intersects open issue #7 and should not be encouraged until the public reuse license is deliberate.

targets.name: Minding Your Mind resource directory
targets.evidence: Public resource-submission form accepting national resources/services, with organization and mission fields.
targets.fit_note: Do not submit until organizational/contact eligibility is confirmed; present CBT Cards as educational/self-reflection material, not treatment.

targets.name: Mental Health @ Home resource directory
targets.evidence: Curated directory explicitly covering free mental-health workbooks, worksheets, CBT/DBT resources, apps, and coping tools.
targets.fit_note: High topical fit for free worksheets, but no verified submission workflow was found in the initial research pass; avoid unsolicited outreach until a current path is confirmed.
